input.command: python3 -c "import os, duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; out='./out'; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True); con=duckdb.connect(); df=con.execute(\"SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year, SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed,0))::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths FROM read_parquet('./data/crashes.parquet') WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year\").df(); df.to_csv(out+'/values_1.csv',index=False); df.to_csv(out+'/values_2.csv',index=False); plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); plt.plot(df.year,df.pedestrian_deaths,marker='o',linewidth=2.5,color='#2457A7'); plt.xticks(df.year,rotation=45); plt.yticks(range(0,201,25)); plt.ylim(0,200); plt.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); plt.title('Pedestrian deaths in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025'); plt.xlabel('Year'); plt.ylabel('Pedestrian deaths'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out+'/option_1.png',dpi=180); plt.close(); plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); bars=plt.bar(df.year.astype(str),df.pedestrian_deaths,color='#4C78A8'); plt.bar_label(bars,padding=3,fontsize=8); plt.ylim(0,200); plt.yticks(range(0,201,25)); plt.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); plt.gca().set_axisbelow(True); plt.title('Pedestrian deaths in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year'); plt.xlabel('Year'); plt.ylabel('Pedestrian deaths'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out+'/option_2.png',dpi=180); plt.close(); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print('saved charts and values in',out)"
